revenue.description: USD sales revenue from completed orders, excluding pending and cancelled orders. No taxes, refunds, or discounts are modeled.

completed_orders.description: Number of distinct completed orders. Joining line items duplicates orders; always count distinct IDs.

average_order_value.description: Completed-order revenue divided by distinct completed orders; NULL when there are no completed orders.

examples.question: What is our total revenue and completed order count?
examples.sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM sales_demo.orders o JOIN sales_demo.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

examples.question: What is revenue by month?
examples.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM sales_demo.orders o JOIN sales_demo.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY month
